meta.name: toolhive-cli-user
meta.description: Guide for using ToolHive CLI (thv) to run and manage MCP servers and skills. Use when running, listing, stopping, building, or configuring MCP servers locally. Covers server lifecycle, registry browsing, secrets management, client registration, groups, container builds, exports, permissions, network isolation, authentication, and skill management (install, uninstall, list, info, build, push, validate). NOT for Kubernetes operator usage or ToolHive development/contributing.
